agent_readiness.notes: Findable: no Google/Bing business listing could be found for the East Brunswick office, and the address search surfaced only unrelated tenants - so an assistant looking for this firm would likely return the wrong lawyer. Answerable: address, phone and practice text are crawlable, but there are no hours, no LocalBusiness schema and no prices. Bookable: a labelled home-page form exists with no CAPTCHA, but there is no calendar and no mapped listing to reach it from.

scores.reasons: Gap: no discoverable map listing, no click-to-call, placeholder titles, weak reviews. Ability to pay: solo contingency practice. Ease: profile setup and on-page fixes are fast wins. Evidence: site observed directly, but listing evidence is indirect because no place page exists.

caveats: Google Maps would not return ratings or review counts in an unauthenticated browser session ('limited view'). All rating and review figures here come from Bing Maps, which surfaces Yelp and other aggregator data, or from directory pages - they are third-party figures and may lag the live Google profile.
Google search and DuckDuckGo both served bot/CAPTCHA challenges from this network, so on-page observations were made by loading each site directly in Chrome rather than through search results.
Whether a Google Business Profile is 'claimed' could not be verified without signing in; findability scores reflect what a visitor can see (hours, category, photos, reviews, link health) instead.
Phone screenshots were captured at 390x844 CSS pixels with device emulation; 'no tel: link' findings are based on DOM inspection (a[href^="tel:"]).
data_gaps: B00005 Tournour Law / SFL Family Law: the site (newjerseydivorceattorney.com) returned a persistent Cloudflare 'Performing security verification' interstitial in a real Chrome session and HTTP 403 to every automated fetch. No home page, contact page or booking flow could be inspected directly; those findings rely on the map listing and search-index metadata.

B00005: batch.json merges two different practices that share 1 South Woodland Avenue - Tournour Law (Frank E. Tournour, 732-913-3634, newjerseydivorceattorney.com) and SFL Family Law LLC (Samantha Figueroa Latif, 732-253-5677, sflfamilylaw.com). Which one the batch intends is unclear; the listed website and phone point to Tournour Law, so that is what was triaged, and SFL was only spot-checked (it shows a 2023 copyright, a working form and tel: links).
B00001 Rothblatt Law: rothblattlaw.com and www.rothblattlaw.com return no DNS record, so no page could be reviewed. Contact details were taken from search-indexed URLs that are no longer resolvable.

B00012 Lang: no Google or Bing place listing exists for the East Brunswick office, so there is no map rating or review count; searching the name returned a different attorney (Steven A. Lang, Denville). Ratings quoted come from FindLaw and Martindale only.

Ratings/review counts were not visible for Gorostiaga, Shawki, Ahmad & Hussain, Eder, Bryak and Kemeny - those listings appear to have no aggregated review data on the sources checked, so 'not shown' means none was displayed, not that the firm has no reviews.
Ahmad & Hussain's contact form is a cross-origin LeadConnector iframe, so field labels and any CAPTCHA inside it could not be inspected from the parent page.
